_readme: atomico.com /team/<slug> pages (Next.js/Hygraph), newest capture on disk per person (Common Crawl, index-query citation, or the Internet Archive), parsed 2026-09-26: name, the site's own group (hero pretitle: Venture, Growth, ...), a title read from the bio's own sentence where it states one, socials from the page's own sidebar, and the companies the page lists under the person (the site's attribution map). A capture is dated: a person captured in 2021 may have left since (capture_ts).

rows.name: Abigail Daniels
rows.bio: Abbie is Communications Director at Atomico, where she splits her time between supporting the later stage portfolio and building the Atomico brand. She helps growth companies grow best-in-class communications teams and navigate the challenges that come with growth funding moments, including IPOs and liquidity events

rows.name: Adam Lasri
rows.title: Principal
rows.bio: Adam is a Principal at Atomico, based in Paris, where he leads our geo coverage for France, Spain, Portugal and Italy. He is responsible for sourcing, due diligence and managing our partnerships with our companies in these territories.

rows.name: Alvaro Campos
rows.title: Associate
rows.bio: Alvaro is an Associate at Atomico, based in London, where he works on sourcing, due diligence, and portfolio management for growth stage companies. He primarily focuses on the UK and Southern European markets.

rows.name: Amanda Hultman
rows.title: VP at Atomico, based in London, where she works on sourcing, due diligence, and portfolio management for early stage companies
rows.bio: Amanda is a VP at Atomico, based in London, where she works on sourcing, due diligence, and portfolio management for early stage companies. She primarily focuses on the Nordic and Baltic markets.

rows.name: Andrea Anzola Verano
rows.title: Associate
rows.bio: Andrea is an Associate at Atomico, based in London, where she focuses on late stage investment opportunities across enterprise and consumer. She is responsible for sourcing, due diligence and providing ongoing support to investments at Series B and beyond.

rows.name: Andreas Helbig
rows.title: Partner
rows.bio: Andreas is a Partner at Atomico, focusing on B2B — particularly SMB SaaS, vertical SaaS, and B2B Marketplaces — and leading our coverage in the Nordic and Baltic regions.

rows.name: Andrew Duncan
rows.bio: Andrew is a Talent Director at Atomico, based in London, where he supports portfolio companies in finding and hiring elite executive talent. He’s responsible for advising founders on the evolution of their leadership teams and oversees the Atomico Expert Network (AEN), designed to provide portfolio companies with access to proven technology leaders regardless of function or geography.

rows.name: Anna Linderum Thomsen
rows.title: Partner
rows.bio: Anna Linderum Thomsen is a Partner within the Investor Relations team at Atomico. Based in London, she oversees fundraising activities and manages relationships with investors globally.

rows.name: Ashleigh Brown
rows.bio: Ashleigh is Sustainability Manager at Atomico, where she splits her time between supporting the portfolio in their Conscious Scaling efforts and building out Atomico’s practices as a responsible investor. She works in partnership with founders to help them harness the power of sustainable growth.

rows.name: Ashleigh Fawcett
rows.bio: Ashleigh is Sustainability Director at Atomico, where she splits her time between supporting the portfolio in their Conscious Scaling efforts and building out Atomico’s practices as a responsible investor. She works in partnership with founders to help them harness the power of sustainable growth.

rows.name: Ben Blume
rows.title: Partner
rows.bio: Ben is a Partner on the investment team at Atomico. He leads investments in companies using AI to automate core enterprise functions, and in those bringing advanced software into complex physical industries like logistics, manufacturing and healthcare.

rows.name: Bryce Keane
rows.bio: Bryce is Atomico’s Communications Partner, based in London, where he focuses on helping our founders tell their stories to the right audience on a global scale. He is our in-house storyteller, media strategist, wordsmith, connector and fixer; as well as our resident Aussie.

rows.name: Camilla Richards
rows.title: Partner
rows.bio: Camilla Richards is Partner and Head of Investor Relations at Atomico, based in London. She oversees fundraising and the firm’s relationships with its investors globally. Camilla is passionate about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion and is actively involved in furthering DEI across the alternatives industry as Chair of Atomico's DEI Task Force.

rows.name: Caroline Chayot
rows.title: Partner
rows.bio: Caroline is Partner and Chief People Officer at Atomico, based in London, where she helps portfolio companies hire, develop and retain the best talent in Europe – a key factor in the success of any fast-growing business.

rows.name: Carter Adamson
rows.bio: Carter focuses on Growth Stage investments, and specifically Atomico’s US investments, which have included Compass, Clutter, MasterClass and Attentive. As a… veteran of the tech scene he also has a lot of long boring stories about how phones once were, like, plugged into walls and stuff.

rows.name: Chirag Modi
rows.title: VP at Atomico, based in London, where he focuses on late stage investment opportunities across enterprise and consumer
rows.bio: Chirag is a VP at Atomico, based in London, where he focuses on late stage investment opportunities across enterprise and consumer. He is responsible for sourcing, due diligence and providing ongoing support to investments at Series B and beyond.

rows.name: Chris Barnes
rows.title: Partner
rows.bio: Chris Barnes is Partner and Chief Operating Officer at Atomico. Based in London, he works across all aspects of Atomico’s operations. He oversees fund management, investor relations, finance, legal and IT. He served on the board of LendInvest until the company’s successful IPO in 2021.

rows.name: Dan Hynes
rows.title: Partner
rows.bio: Dan is Partner, Talent at Atomico, based in London. He is responsible for leading and evolving our Growth Acceleration Team who help portfolio companies scale to category winners. Dan brings extensive global experience in technology talent and staffing to help portfolio companies find, grow and retain the best employees as well as build high performing teams.

rows.name: Daphne Dovermann
rows.title: Principal
rows.bio: Daphne is a Principal at Atomico, focused on our early stage investments in the UK and Benelux, alongside a vertical focus on Consumer internet and Climate. She works on sourcing, due diligence and portfolio management.

rows.name: Don Hoang
rows.title: Partner
rows.bio: Don is a Partner at Atomico and is based in London. Don leads investments across both the Venture and Growth stages with a core focus on earlier stage companies. He also leads Atomico’s investments in the next frontier of fintech and mobility.

rows.name: Erica Young
rows.bio: Erica is our Community Director, based in London, where she leads our efforts to expand our network, deepen relationships, and build community across the Atomico ecosystem.

rows.name: Federico Ruosi
rows.title: Associate
rows.bio: Federico is an Associate at Atomico, based in London, where he works on sourcing, due diligence, and portfolio management for early stage companies. He primarily focuses on Spain, Italy and Portugal, as well as Central and Eastern European countries.

rows.name: Foucault de Fraguier
rows.title: Associate
rows.bio: Foucault is an Associate at Atomico, based in London, where he works on sourcing, due diligence, and portfolio management for growth stage companies. He primarily focuses on the France, Benelux and DACH markets.

rows.name: Georgia Forbes
rows.bio: Georgia ia a Principal at Atomico, based in London, where she focuses on Growth investment opportunities across enterprise, fintech and consumer. Her role involves sourcing, due diligence, and continued support to portfolio companies from Series B onwards.

rows.name: Hillary Ball
rows.title: Partner
rows.bio: Hillary Ball is a Partner at Atomico. Based in London, Hillary focuses on Atomico’s growth stage investing, with a particular interest in software, consumer internet, and marketplace companies. She currently sits on the boards of TravelPerk, Wellhub and Framer, and additionally led our investment in Nourish.

rows.name: Hiro Tamura
rows.title: Partner
rows.bio: Hiro Tamura is a Partner at Atomico. He oversees the day to day operations of Atomico's investment team and also leads the firm's growth-stage (Series B and above) strategy and investments.

rows.name: Irina Haivas
rows.title: Partner
rows.bio: Irina is a Partner on the investment team based in London, where she focuses on investments in AI, enterprise software, and health and bio.

rows.name: Joen Bonnier
rows.title: Partner
rows.bio: Joen is Partner, Corporate Development at Atomico where he supports the firm’s portfolio in later stage financing rounds, M&A and liquidity events, leading the firm’s engagement with growth investors, global corporates and institutional investors. He served on the board of Truecaller until September 2021.

rows.name: Julia Prada
rows.bio: Julia Prada is Corporate Development Director at Atomico, based in London. She provides our portfolio companies with experience and support to execute late stage financing rounds, M&A and liquidity events.

rows.name: Kasit Rochanakorn
rows.title: Partner
rows.bio: Kasit Rochanakorn is Partner and General Counsel at Atomico based in London. Kasit provides guidance to the Atomico investment teams on the negotiation and execution of investments, divestments and portfolio management as well as helping to oversee fundraising, ESG and regulatory compliance at the firm.

rows.name: Katharine McCallum
rows.title: Associate
rows.bio: Katharine is an Associate on the Investment team in London, where she works on sourcing, due diligence and portfolio management for early-stage companies. She is the market lead for UK & Ireland.

rows.name: Konstantin Zedelius
rows.title: Principal
rows.bio: Konstantin is a Principal at Atomico focusing primarily on the DACH region, where he is actively sourcing and investing in B2B and consumer internet companies.

rows.name: Kristina Raggl
rows.title: Principal
rows.bio: Kristina is a Principal on the Investor Relations team at Atomico, working to oversee fundraising activities and manage relationships with investors globally.

rows.name: Laura Connell
rows.title: Partner
rows.bio: Laura is a Partner at Atomico, based in London, where she leads on new investment opportunities at the growth stage across enterprise, consumer and fintech.

rows.name: Lisa Sorg
rows.title: VP on the Venture team, focusing on the DACH and Benelux markets
rows.bio: Lisa is a VP on the Venture team, focusing on the DACH and Benelux markets. Based in Berlin, she leads our local office, where she spearheads the sourcing and due diligence of new investment opportunities, as well as portfolio management across both B2B and B2C sectors.

rows.name: Luca Eisenstecken
rows.title: Partner
rows.bio: Luca is a Partner on the investment team, based in London. He focuses on Atomico’s growth stage investing, with a particular interest in the Enterprise space. He sits on the boards of Aiven, ChannelEngine, Factorial, TestGorilla and Scoutbee, and worked on Atomico's partnerships with Attentive, Commsor and Messagebird.

rows.name: Marta Naidenova
rows.title: VP on the Investment team in London, where she works on sourcing and due diligence of new investment opportunities as well as portfolio management
rows.bio: Marta is a VP on the Investment team in London, where she works on sourcing and due diligence of new investment opportunities as well as portfolio management. She is the market lead for UK & Ireland, and also spends time on various topics in the B2B space across Europe.

rows.name: Mathieu Marc
rows.title: VP on the Investment team in London
rows.bio: Mathieu is a VP on the Investment team in London. He primarily focuses on France and other early stage investment opportunities (Seed / Series A) across Europe.

rows.name: Maxine Smith
rows.title: Associate
rows.bio: Maxine Smith is an Associate on the Investment Team based in London. She supports on Investment Operations, the Angel Programme, and the Fund of Funds Programme.

rows.name: Miguel Rodrigo Perez
rows.title: VP in London, where he focuses on the sourcing and due diligence of new investment opportunities in the UK & Ireland, as well as portfolio management for early stage companies
rows.bio: Miguel is a VP in London, where he focuses on the sourcing and due diligence of new investment opportunities in the UK & Ireland, as well as portfolio management for early stage companies.

rows.name: Niall Wass
rows.title: Adviser
rows.bio: Niall Wass is an Adviser to Atomico, where he helps portfolio companies in the consumer space and marketplaces with their growth strategy and scaling. Niall serves on the boards of Koru Kids, Habito, OnTruck and Jobandtalent. He has also worked closely with Lendinvest, Fat Llama, Lilium and Clutter.

rows.name: Niklas Zennström
rows.title: CEO
rows.bio: Niklas is CEO and Founding Partner at Atomico. He is an experienced technology investor and entrepreneur, having previously co-founded and managed globally successful technology companies including Skype, Kazaa and Joltid. Niklas founded Atomico in 2006. He is passionate about partnering with founders solving big challenges facing our planet with digital technology.

rows.name: Olga Ayers
rows.bio: Olga is Legal Director at Atomico based in London. Olga splits her time between running the firm’s partnerships with its portfolio, supporting founders and generally getting involved in all things legal.

rows.name: Paddy Lambros
rows.bio: Paddy is a Talent Director at Atomico, based in London. He supports our portfolio companies and founders to find, hire, and develop world class teams.

rows.name: Pranav Vangala
rows.title: VP, based in London, where he focuses on Growth investment opportunities across enterprise and consumer, with an interest in Bio and Health
rows.bio: Pranav is a VP, based in London, where he focuses on Growth investment opportunities across enterprise and consumer, with an interest in Bio and Health. He is responsible for sourcing, due diligence and providing ongoing support to investments at Series B and beyond.

rows.name: Rowen Pham
rows.title: Associate
rows.bio: Rowen is an Associate at Atomico, based in London, where he focuses on late stage investment opportunities across enterprise and consumer. He is responsible for sourcing, due diligence and providing ongoing support to investments at Series B and beyond.

rows.name: Sarah Guemouri
rows.title: Head of Insights based in London
rows.bio: Sarah is Head of Insights based in London, part of the Insights function at Atomico, and co-author of the State of European Tech report. She is responsible for Intelligence initiatives at Atomico, such as research supporting sourcing and evaluation of investment opportunities, providing regular insights on investment activity, competitive intelligence and key technology trends.

rows.name: Sasha Astafyeva
rows.title: Partner
rows.bio: Sasha is a Partner at Atomico, based in London, where she leads on new investment opportunities in the consumer space. She is responsible for sourcing, due diligence and managing our partnerships with consumer companies.

rows.name: Sasha Vidiborskiy
rows.title: Partner
rows.bio: Sasha Vidiborskiy is a Partner at Atomico, based in London. He focuses on enterprise software, including blockchain/web3, developer tools and AI/ML applications, among others. He has led our investments in Mondoo and Ben , and is on the boards of Jobandtalent , CloudNC , Varjo .

rows.name: Shamal Thakar
rows.title: Director in the Growth Acceleration Team
rows.bio: Shamal is a Director in the Growth Acceleration Team. He works with our portfolio to build, structure and negotiate commercial and strategic partnerships with some of the world's most exciting brands.

rows.name: Siraj Khaliq
rows.title: Adviser
rows.bio: Siraj Khaliq is an Adviser and former Atomico-backed founder himself. He focuses on Frontier Technologies (companies built upon engineering or scientific breakthroughs), including AI and computer vision, novel semiconductors, quantum computing and synthetic biology.

rows.name: Soline Kauffmann-Tourkestansky
rows.bio: Soline is our ESG & Sustainability Director. Based in London, she focuses on helping founders adopt best practice when it comes to creating sustainable value for their businesses and all stakeholders involved.

rows.name: Terese Hougaard
rows.title: Partner
rows.bio: Terese is a Partner based in London and works on the investment team, focusing on early stage B2B opportunities across climate and fintech. She led Atomico's investments in Abacum, Vaayu, and Opna.

rows.name: Thibaut Ceyrolle
rows.title: Adviser
rows.bio: Thibaut is an Adviser in the Growth Acceleration team at Atomico. He works with our portfolio to build effective Go-to-Market strategies and Sales functions.

rows.name: Tom Wehmeier
rows.title: Partner
rows.bio: Tom is Partner and Head of Intelligence at Atomico, based in London, where he runs our Insights team. The team’s mission is to share data and insights to help us make better decisions and have more informed conversations with the people who matter most to us (founders, LPs, etc). Tom is also the founder of our annual, industry-defining State of European Tech Report.

rows.name: Victor Jolly
rows.title: Associate
rows.bio: Victor is an Associate at Atomico, based in Paris, where he works on sourcing, due diligence, and portfolio management for early-stage companies. He primarily focuses on France.
